surfaces.condition: A material feature, functionality, behavior, CLI/API, workflow, data, integration, security/privacy, or quality/release change is added or changed.
validation: Update this matrix in the same change with affected surfaces, contracts, documentation, tests, evidence, owners, and projections.

surfaces.condition: catalog, skill contract, installer, or validation behavior changes
The repository is Compass-managed and an addition, change, removal, or fold changes a root or subsystem boundary, declared path, parent outcome, or cross-compass link.
validation: Run the operation-specific Compass closure checks before accepting the matrix operation.

surfaces.condition: a distributed skill, workflow, route, or install mapping changes

reviewed_no_impact.reason: Internal responsibility split only; CLI arguments, import facade, schemas, catalog behavior, provider projections, and installation mappings are unchanged.

add: Register every new root or subsystem compass and its declared paths.
Validate parent outcomes and cross-compass links before accepting coverage.
change: Reconcile changed purpose, boundary, paths, parent outcomes, links, continuity, and quiz answers.
Run family validation and scoring after the changed truth is recorded.
remove: Retire removed scopes and preserve their history instead of deleting the record.
Remove or resolve dangling paths, parent outcomes, and cross-compass links.
fold: Compare source and target compass families before accepting the folded result.
Preserve source-only or conflicting truth as active, retired, or explicitly unresolved; never infer product progress from the fold alone.
Run family validation and scoring against the post-fold tree.
